fieldValues.title: Cycle and report
fieldValues.article_text: The cycle runs Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 18:00 UTC. The nightly lane runs do the building and reviewing. On Sunday the Steward closes the cycle and posts the report on semanticops.com#31 before the owner's Monday review. The report uses the standard run-report headings plus figures: PRs merged with their quorum line, PRs open, stops, red gates, budget used, and the open-divergence count.
fieldValues.rationale: The owner reviews on Monday; the report must be there first.
fieldValues.amendment_rule: Owner only: an amendment needs a new owner-ratified decision.
fieldValues.protected_status: Agent testimony until the owner ratifies the charter decision.
